literal_meaning: অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ যা হঠাৎ বা দ্রুত কোনো কাজের শব্দ প্রকাশ করে (onomatopoeic sound mimicking sudden action)
similar_in_english: in the blink of an eye
example_sentences_in_bangla: ধাঁ করে কাজটা শেষ করে দাও।
example_sentences_in_english: Finish the work in a flash.
He got up in a flash.
history: This idiom has variants influenced by Odia and Hindi linguistic traditions, reflecting cross-regional onomatopoeic expressions in South Asian languages.
note: The idiom is primarily onomatopoeic and used colloquially across Bengal and neighboring regions.
